from: The Good tab: the board follows it
intro: What makes a screen good here. Each good one is good for its own reason, and each can still get better.

made.text: Agents that know nothing else: a few words, the screen, a bare wrapper.
made.title: Envision, on a blank sheet

made.text: The candidates and our good screens for that job, one line on what is good in each.
made.title: Merge with the good ones

made.text: A real place, real data, the facts checked.
made.title: Make it real

rule: A screen goes on the canvas only when it looks better than the one it replaces and adds something. Nothing unnecessary: one thing removed before one is added. Nothing is ever finished.

share.text: The sign, the ticket, the clock, the window. Its readings are the data.
share.title: A real thing from the place carries the answer

share.text: It ends in a sentence or a button that settles it.
share.title: One question, answered at a glance

share.text: Empty space stays empty. Calm and warm are allowed, never required.
share.title: Rich but calm

share.text: Your gate, your pace, your table at 19:30; never about the app.
share.title: About you and the moment

share.text: What is missing is one small question, not the screen.
share.title: Honest in a few words

share.text: How it looks and what it does for you; neither traded for the other.
share.title: Both sides worked out

share.text: Visuals at a glance when they add value. No lines of text
share.title: Visuals instead of text
